title: Residual derived compatibility for the supported source
statement: For a normalized diagonal coefficient diagram d on a projective line, the canonical right-derived single comparison of the supported source, followed by the fixed second direct-image comparison, equals the inverse support normalization followed by the canonical derived section comparison and supported-unit comparison.

source.place: Second identity, residual compatibility after removing the ordinary support isomorphism.

proof.text: Evaluate the canonical right-derived unit on the supported source. Use the support normalization to identify the ordinary source isomorphism with the closed diagonal followed by the second projection, then transport this equality through the canonical derived pushforward comparison and the conjugate section isomorphism. The resulting residual compatibility is exactly the displayed equation.

theorem supported_source_arrow_derived_core
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (L : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, Modules Λ X)
    (d : Diagram Λ Y L) :
    diagonalTraceRightSingle
          (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ (secondProjection Y)) d.R₂
          (source Λ Y) ≫
        (secondDiagramPushIso Λ Y L d).hom.app
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules Λ (diagonalSurface Y)) 0).obj
            (source Λ Y)) =
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules Λ (ProjectiveLine Y)) 0).map d.support₂.iso.inv ≫
        (pushSectionIso Λ Y).hom.app (unit Λ (ProjectiveLine Y)) ≫
        (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward Λ (secondProjection Y)).map
          (supportedUnitIso Λ Y).hom
